name: Topferty Cotton Special (कापूस स्पेशल)
description: Specialized Organic Manure formulated by Bhagyodaya Industries for Cotton crops (कापूस). Boosts soil organic carbon, promotes deep taproot anchorage, minimizes square & boll dropping, and maximizes lint yield & fiber quality.
benefits: Promotes heavy branch tillering and boll retention in cotton
High organic carbon & humic active matter for moisture retention
Prevents square shedding and optimizes leaf photosynthetic index
100% Organic Manure certified under FCO norms
composition: Organic Carbon > 14%, Total NPK (Organic), Bio-active Compost Carrier, Moisture Max 25%
dosage: Basal / Top Dressing: 50 kg to 100 kg / Acre during vegetative & pre-flowering stages

name: A1 MYCO (Granular) Mycorrhizal Biofertiliser
description: Granular Mycorrhizal Biofertiliser (मायकोरिजल जैव उर्वरक) by Bhagyodaya Industries. Multiplies feeder root surface area, mobilizes locked soil phosphorus & micronutrients, and enhances drought resilience.
benefits: Extensive mycorrhizal fungal network for deep root branching
Mobilizes insoluble phosphorus, zinc, and micronutrients
Significantly enhances soil moisture and drought tolerance
Eco-friendly bio-fertilizer for all field and horticultural crops
composition: Mycorrhizal Inoculum with Organic Granular Bio-carrier
dosage: Soil Application: 4 kg / Acre at sowing or basal root zone application

name: HUM UP Potassium Humate (99% Solubility)
description: Ultra-pure 99% Soluble Potassium Humate by Bhagyodaya Industries. Stimulates rapid white root development, enhances cation exchange capacity, and improves fertilizer uptake efficiency.
benefits: 99% high water solubility ideal for drip fertigation and foliar spray
Rapidly triggers active white feeder root proliferation
Improves soil physical texture, aeration, and nutrient retention
Enhances plant chlorophyll synthesis and overall crop vigor
composition: Potassium Humate (99% Water Soluble active humic fractions)
dosage: Drip/Soil: 1 kg to 2 kg / Acre | Foliar: 1g to 1.5g per Liter of water

name: Nutriesol Mix Micronutrient Fertilizer (Grade No - 2)
description: Maharashtra Grade No – 2 Mix Micronutrient Fertilizer (Foliar Spray & Drip Fertilizer - DF) manufactured by Bhagyodaya Industries. Supplies balanced Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu, Mo, and B to prevent chlorosis and boost yield quality.
benefits: Balanced 6-in-1 formulation: Fe (2.5%), Mn (1.0%), Zn (3.0%), Cu (1.0%), Mo (0.1%), B (0.5%)
Corrects hidden micronutrient deficiencies rapidly within short time
Boosts plant immunity, flowering retention, and uniform fruit bulking
100% water-soluble formulation suitable for foliar spray and drip
composition: Iron (Fe) 2.50%, Manganese (Mn) 1.00%, Zinc (Zn) 3.00%, Copper (Cu) 1.00%, Molybdenum (Mo) 0.10%, Boron (B) 0.50%
dosage: Foliar Spray / Drip: Dissolve 1.5 g Nutriesol in 1 Litre of clean water

name: Fast Target Six in One Bio Stimulant (Liquid 5L)
description: FCO Registered Six-in-One Bio Stimulant liquid for foliar application. Potent mixture of Seaweed extract, Humic & Fulvic acid, Amino acids, Vitamin C, Glycine, and Organic Carbon.
benefits: Synergistic 6-in-1 formulation for maximum foliar absorption
Promotes vegetative surge, branching, and heavy flower setting
Mitigates climate stress, moisture deficit, and temperature fluctuations
FCO Registered govt. compliant formulation by Bhagyodaya Industries
composition: Seaweed Extract, Humic & Fulvic Acid, Amino Acids & Vitamins, Vitamin C, Glycine, Organic Carbon
dosage: Foliar Application: 2 ml to 2.5 ml per Liter of water (500 ml / Acre)

name: Topferty Soyabean Special (सोयाबीन स्पेशल)
description: Targeted organic fertilizer for Soybean crops (सोयाबीन). Promotes heavy nodulation, vigorous early vegetative growth, pod filling, and higher oil and protein content in seeds.
benefits: Enhances nitrogen-fixing root nodule formation
Improves pod development and seed test weight
Increases drought resistance and moisture holding capacity
ISO 9001:2015 certified organic manure formulation
composition: Enriched Organic Manure with Bio-active Humates & Essential Micro-elements
dosage: Soil application: 50 kg / Acre at sowing or early vegetative stage

name: Topferty Paddy Special (भात स्पेशल)
description: Specialized Organic Manure for Paddy & Rice (भात). Engineered for submerged and puddled soil conditions to prevent nutrient loss, stimulate profuse tillering, and produce bold, filled grains.
benefits: Triggers maximum tillers per hill in paddy fields
Reduces nutrient leaching in flooded wetland soils
Prevents premature lodging through strong root grip
Improves grain luster, density, and panicle weight
composition: Humified Organic Matter, Nitrogen & Phosphorus fixing carriers, Trace minerals
dosage: 50 kg to 100 kg / Acre during puddling/transplanting and panicle initiation

name: Topferty Banana & Turmeric Special (केळी - हळद)
description: Specialized high-potency Organic Manure formulated for Banana & Turmeric crops (केळी - हळद). Accelerates rhizome development in turmeric and uniform bunch development & finger sizing in banana.
benefits: Accelerates bulky rhizome growth and curcumin percentage in turmeric
Enhances banana pseudostem girth, bunch weight, and hands count
Maintains optimum soil pH and beneficial rhizospheric microbes
Reduces transplant shock and root nematodes vulnerability
composition: Organic Carbon, Potassium-rich organic biomass, Humic acids, Bio-enrichers
dosage: 50 kg - 100 kg / Acre in split applications during root development and bulking

name: Topferty Sugarcane Special (ऊस स्पेशल)
description: Specialized Organic Manure for Sugarcane (ऊस). Stimulates deep rooting, heavy tillering (shoots), thick cane internode formation, and maximizes sucrose sugar content.
benefits: Boosts millable cane stalks and tillering per clump
Improves cane thickness, internode length, and sugar recovery (Brix)
Retains moisture during long sugarcane crop cycles
Excellent for both planted cane and ratoon crop management
composition: Enriched Organic Matrix, Organic Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium & Humic fractions
dosage: 100 kg / Acre at planting / earthing up stage

name: Fast Target Bio-Stimulant Granule
description: FCO Registered advanced Bio-stimulant granule with Seaweed extract, Protein Hydrolysate (amino acids), and high-grade Humic acid. Triggers extreme root growth, stress tolerance, and heavy yield response across all cash crops.
benefits: Contains Alginic acid, Fucoidan, and free Amino acids (0.5% min)
Rapidly activates dormant feeder roots within 48-72 hours
FCO Registered 1985 certified bio-stimulant standard
Unlocks locked soil micro and macro nutrients
composition: Seaweed Extract (Alginic acid >= 0.02%, Fucoidan >= 0.02%), Free Amino Acids >= 0.5%, Total Amino Acids >= 0.6%, Humic Acid & Organic Carbon >= 1%
dosage: Soil application: 5 kg to 10 kg / Acre at vegetative & flowering stages

name: Microzyme Crop+ (Seaweed Extract 2% Granule)
description: FCO Registered pure Ascophyllum nodosum Seaweed extract granule (2%). Delivers natural plant growth hormones to stimulate white root development, disease resistance, and peak crop yields.
benefits: 100% natural cold-water Ascophyllum nodosum marine algae formulation
Triggers profuse white feeder root generation and nutrient uptake
Alginic acid per cent by weight min 0.006%, Total organic carbon min 1.4%
Improves crop greening, tillering, and abiotic climate shock resilience
composition: Seaweed (Ascophyllum nodosum) Extract 2% (Granule), Alginic Acid, Organic Carbon >= 1.4%, pH 7.0 - 9.0
dosage: 10 kg / Acre in two split soil applications

name: Topferty Onion Special (कांदा स्पेशल)
description: Specialized Organic Manure formulated for Onion crops (कांदा). Promotes large bulb size, uniform color, thick outer skin layers, and long shelf life in storage.
benefits: Promotes uniform bulb expansion and prevents splitting
Increases storage shelf life and reduces rotting losses
Enriches soil with vital organic nutrients for allium crops
Improves pungency, firmness, and market grade value
composition: Specialized Organic Carbon, Sulfur & Potassium rich organic humus matrix
dosage: 50 kg to 100 kg / Acre at transplanting and bulb formation stage
